snippet.title: How to Set Up & Play Pixreveal's Twitch Chat Game
snippet.description:
Play PixReveal with your Twitch chat. Just enter your Twitch channel name, hit the start button and you are ready to go. You guess the pixel images together. Your Twitch viewers can answer via the chat. Typing the answer directly or simply typing 1, 2, 3 or 4.

#twitch #twitchstreamer #twitchchat #guessthepicture
